overall_mobile.reason: Native two-thumb play supported three recoveries and boss progress, but navigation and precise combat took substantial paused inspection. Limited to one loss.

controls.reason: Movement, scene turning and simultaneous held FIRE-drag worked. DASH, AIM, reload and USE responded visibly. Dense right-side controls and fine aim corrections were demanding; 18% accuracy is this reviewer’s result, not proof of an input defect.

gameplay.reason: Recoveries, guarded lanes, shields and exposed coil windows created distinct tasks and tactical choices. Coil shutdown gave tangible progress. Unseen upload and final completion limit confidence.

presentation.reason: Rain, wet surfaces, cyan/amber contrast, industrial architecture and large location signs establish a cohesive mood. Software rendering and still inspection cannot establish phone performance or audio quality.

usability.reason: Handbook, paused overview/local route maps, distance-to-reach prompt and clear terminal stats help. Archive exit routing and columns obscuring the custodian repeatedly interrupted progress.

readability.reason: Health/ammo, recovered memories, and armored/exposed/numbered-coil states were clear. Small threat text, compact compass and PATH cues were harder to interpret; a close wall could fill nearly all scene space.

terminal_ui: Memories cached. Retry at the uplink with a fresh suit and a full Custodian, or start fresh.
review1Outcome.mission_coverage: All three memories recovered; custodian reached and two coils disabled. Last preterminal capture: 1 OFF, 2 100%, 3 OFF. No confirmed custodian defeat or upload/extraction.

next: Fresh portrait Sol reviewer on unchanged snapshot; no target score or prior findings supplied.
